question: What is the name of India’s first Ayurvedic diagnostic device developed in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nadi Tarangini**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nadi Tarangini** is India’s first **Ayurvedic diagnostic device**, developed to digitize and modernize the ancient science of pulse-based diagnosis (*Nadi Pariksha*).
 
• This device was developed in **January 2025** to enable accurate and consistent health analysis using Ayurvedic principles combined with modern technology.
 
• The device uses **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** and advanced sensors to capture a person’s pulse data and analyze it to determine their health condition.
 
• It is specifically designed to assist **Ayurvedic practitioners** in diagnosing diseases and suggesting personalized treatment plans.
 
• By integrating technology with traditional medicine, **Nadi Tarangini** aims to bring consistency, accuracy, and scalability to Ayurvedic diagnostics.
